cohort: The study included 444 women exposed to risankizumab prior to and during pregnancy.
finding: The study found reassuring data, with fewer than 10 adverse pregnancy outcomes among 444 exposed women and zero cases of preterm birth, suggesting risankizumab is safe to administer prior to and during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was one of the adverse pregnancy outcomes analyzed, with fewer than 10 cases reported among the exposed women.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age was an outcome measured.
gest_age: Preterm birth and small for gestational age were outcomes measured.
